name: 888Pool
summary: 888Pool is a free-to-play browser-based 8-ball billiards game. Players can compete against real opponents worldwide, practice against AI opponents, communicate through private in-game chat and customize their player profiles. The game features global rankings, 14-day competitive cycles and a community rewards system. Cash prizes are unlocked once the community reaches 1,000 qualifying real players. No entry fees, deposits, betting or subscriptions are required.
